leadText:
A Young Couple (Japanese: ラブラブカップル Love-Love Couple) are a pair of Pokémon Trainers that first debuted in the Generation III games. They are depicted as a couple in their teens or early twenties.

They use usually of opposite genders or in duos for Double Battles.
